title: Data Scientist - (Logistics, Seamless Deliveries)
description: As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero. Job Description We are on the lookout for a Data Scientist to join the Seamless Deliveries domain of the Customer Logistics tribe in our mission to deliver consistently amazing customer experiences. You will work alongside other data professionals designing and deploying advanced models to solve complex problems, delivering revenue for Delivery Hero at the frontline of our growth & profitability journey. At Delivery Hero, we are exploring ways to optimize our delivery times and perfect our forecasting and estimation abilities. We are developing and enhancing a range of products to better predict delivery times, optimize fleet operations, and improve the customer ordering experience.. The Customer Logistics tribe’s mission is to build products that make it easy for local brands to run efficient operations and deliver a delightful order experience to customers so they order on repeat. The tribe comprises teams of skilled analysts, engineers, and scientists working together to deliver data solutions affecting every customer journey across all of Delivery Hero’s 70+ markets. If you're a creative problem solver who is hungry for a new adventure, an international workplace is waiting for you in the heart of Berlin! Drive the development and implementation of advanced machine learning models for delivery time prediction, food prep time prediction, vendor consistency, etc. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the efficiency and performance of the machine learning models across the vertical. Analyse large-scale datasets to understand and identify opportunities deploying sophisticated statistical techniques to improve decision making in Time Predictions. Lead research initiatives to explore emerging trends and technologies in machine learning, contributing to the advancement of Delivery Hero's digital products and algorithms. Stay informed about industry developments and incorporate new methodologies and best practices into our data science workflows. Serve as a subject matter expert in data science and machine learning, providing guidance and mentorship to other team members and fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the data science team. Qualifications You excel at modelling business problems using machine learning techniques, covering feature engineering, model selection and design, as well as evaluation and optimisation to deliver value to the business. Expertise in building and training advanced machine learning models with strong knowledge of the Python data toolkit, ideally centring around PyTorch, xgboost, and lightgbm. Through the fluent use of SQL queries, you are able to explore our data universe and gather data to support your analysis and the development of machine learning solutions. Have exposure to distributed cloud systems like Kubernetes, Docker Kafka etc. You are familiar with deploying and developing in cloud systems, ideally with experience in GCP and BigQuery. Experience deploying complex models to serve live traffic and collaborating with ML engineers in creating efficient systems that integrate ML models following good MLOps practices. Additional Information Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape. Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week. We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service. We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses. Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy. Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan. The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses. Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today! We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you. We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.cominclude it in your application. Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration. You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.
descriptionHtml:
As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Data Scientist to join the Seamless Deliveries domain of the Customer Logistics tribe in our mission to deliver consistently amazing customer experiences.

You will work alongside other data professionals designing and deploying advanced models to solve complex problems, delivering revenue for Delivery Hero at the frontline of our growth & profitability journey.

At Delivery Hero, we are exploring ways to optimize our delivery times and perfect our forecasting and estimation abilities. We are developing and enhancing a range of products to better predict delivery times, optimize fleet operations, and improve the customer ordering experience..

The Customer Logistics tribe’s mission is to build products that make it easy for local brands to run efficient operations and deliver a delightful order experience to customers so they order on repeat.

The tribe comprises teams of skilled analysts, engineers, and scientists working together to deliver data solutions affecting every customer journey across all of Delivery Hero’s 70+ markets.

If you're a creative problem solver who is hungry for a new adventure, an international workplace is waiting for you in the heart of Berlin!

  • Drive the development and implementation of advanced machine learning models for delivery time prediction, food prep time prediction, vendor consistency, etc. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the efficiency and performance of the machine learning models across the vertical.
  • Analyse large-scale datasets to understand and identify opportunities deploying sophisticated statistical techniques to improve decision making in Time Predictions.
  • Lead research initiatives to explore emerging trends and technologies in machine learning, contributing to the advancement of Delivery Hero's digital products and algorithms. Stay informed about industry developments and incorporate new methodologies and best practices into our data science workflows.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in data science and machine learning, providing guidance and mentorship to other team members and fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the data science team.

Qualifications

  • You excel at modelling business problems using machine learning techniques, covering feature engineering, model selection and design, as well as evaluation and optimisation to deliver value to the business.
  • Expertise in building and training advanced machine learning models with strong knowledge of the Python data toolkit, ideally centring around PyTorch, xgboost, and lightgbm.
  • Through the fluent use of SQL queries, you are able to explore our data universe and gather data to support your analysis and the development of machine learning solutions.
  • Have exposure to distributed cloud systems like Kubernetes, Docker Kafka etc.
  • You are familiar with deploying and developing in cloud systems, ideally with experience in GCP and BigQuery.
  • Experience deploying complex models to serve live traffic and collaborating with ML engineers in creating efficient systems that integrate ML models following good MLOps practices.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

  • Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week.
  • We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service.
  • We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
  • Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy.
  • Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan.
  • The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.cominclude it in your application.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Data Scientist in Biotech R&D and Process Development (m/f/d)

descriptionHtml:
Who wants to help make a difference?

Society stands at a tipping point, and we all will be affected. There is a need for change, and there is a strong demand for sustainable products that are not based on fossil fuels. By replacing existing unsustainable materials, the AMSilk team is able to make a true change in many industries. Our vision is to enable true change through intelligent biotech materials.

Of course, this won’t happen overnight. It takes the right mix of scientific curiosity, strong engineering, and smart data. In this role, you will develop and integrate advanced Data Science and ML/AI methodologies to accelerate our Biotech R&D and ScaleUp projects. Your mission will be to drive digital transformation across R&D and process development building robust data models, enabling predictive analytics, and deploying automation tools that turn complex data into faster, better, and more confident decisions.

Your responsibility and impact within AMSilk company means to:

  • Develop and deploy data science solutions for process optimization, troubleshooting and performance improvement at all levels (both internally and with external partners)
  • Product Owner for ELN and LIMS, ensuring continuous development and alignment with internal requirements
  • Design and implement data models and ML/AI tools for critical process areas to enable predictive analysis and soft-sensor applications
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, process engineering, automation and IT teams to ensure data integrity and accessibility
  • Provide training and guidance on data manipulation, visualization and analytics tools to the R&D and production teams

Your areas of knowledge and expertise are:

  • Degree in Bio-Chemical Engineering or Natural Sciences (Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Physics, etc.) with strong data science experience
  • Or a Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field
  • 3+ years' experience in data analytics, ML/AI applications and process development in biotech or related industries
  • Proven track record in managing complex, data-driven projects and cross-functional collaboration

We would love to have you in our team if you:

  • Enjoy teamwork and collaboration
  • Have a good sense of humor
  • Are bold, creative and think outside the box
  • Live a solutions-driven approach and have a pragmatic working style
  • Are willing to learn something new every day

What you can expect from us:

  • At AMSilk we believe in providing a well-rounded benefits package that takes care of our employees' health, wealth, and work/life balance. We subsidize public transportation, childcare, and lunch, and offer a company health program to help our employees stay healthy and happy
  • We offer challenging work in a fast-paced environment and provide full support to help you expand your skills, enhance your expertise, and reach your full potential throughout your career journey
  • A community that is both diverse and inclusive, where teammates feel empowered to share their ideas and work together creatively

About Us

AMSilk is the world's first industrial supplier of smart biotech materials by applying an outstanding technology platform based on silk proteins. AMSilk turns man-made proteins into silk formulations including fiber, hydrogels and silk powder for applications in the textile industry as well as for medical devices and consumer goods. All AMSilk materials are created with an end of life in mind, being completely vegan, biodegradable, using renewable plant-based carbon, with no microplastics.

descriptionHtml:
Standort: Großraum Bamberg

Anstellungsart: Festanstellung – Unbefristet - Vollzeit

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid <90% Remote


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung komplexer Datenanalysen und prädiktiver Modelle
  • Einsatz moderner statistischer Methoden und Machine-Learning-Verfahren
  • Konzeption und Durchführung von Trainings im Bereich Data Analytics
  • Weiterentwicklung von Data-Architecture- und Analytics-Konzepten
  • Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Analyseergebnissen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams


Was Du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, VWL, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science, Advanced Analytics oder vergleichbaren Rollen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python und/oder R sowie SQL
  • Erfahrung mit Big-Data-Technologien, idealerweise Hadoop / Apache Spark
  • Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten
  • Sehr gute C1 Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft, Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Jenkins, GitHub, Eclipse oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Kenntnisse in Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure oder vergleichbar)
  • Erfahrung in Schulungen, Workshops oder Wissensvermittlung
  • Kenntnisse im Aufbau moderner Datenplattformen


Deine Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • Attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsbezogene Zusatzkomponenten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten (hoher Remote-Anteil möglich)
  • 30 Tage Urlaub sowie zusätzliche Sonderurlaubstage
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung und zeitgemäße Tools
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten (Fach- & Methodentrainings)
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Reisekostenübernahme bei dienstlichen Reisen

descriptionHtml:
Data Scientist – Machine Learning & Optimization

Permanent | Full-time | Germany / Hybrid


About the Role

We are supporting an organisation working on complex, data-driven decision-making challenges in a highly dynamic and mission-critical environment.

The role focuses on designing and deploying advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models that directly support strategic and operational decisions, particularly in large-scale, real-world systems.


This is a hands-on, end-to-end role with real operational impact, combining deep analytical work with production deployment and stakeholder interaction.


Your Responsibilities

  • Design and architect machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to support strategic and operational decision-making
  • Take end-to-end ownership of complex, data-driven use cases — from ideation and model design through implementation and productive deployment
  • Develop and apply advanced decision and optimization approaches, including:
  • Linear and integer optimization
  • Heuristic methods
  • Reinforcement learning
  • Translate analytical results into clear, data-driven recommendations and act as a trusted sparring partner for senior stakeholders
  • Deploy models into production and contribute actively to MLOps, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Help evolve the AI and analytics platform, ensuring scalability and reliability
  • Establish best practices for data, models, and analytics workflows
  • Contribute to building and sustaining a data-driven culture across the organisation


Your Profile

  • Several years of professional experience (ideally 6+ years) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or Mathematical Optimization applied to complex business problems
  • Strong track record of innovation, ideally demonstrated through publications, research contributions, or comparable achievements
  • Excellent Python skills and hands-on experience with common data science and ML libraries
  • Deep expertise in time-series forecasting and/or mathematical optimization methods
  • Experience deploying analytics or ML solutions into production environments, preferably cloud-based (e.g. Azure)
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices, monitoring, and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong analytical thinking combined with a clear focus on implementation and business impact
  • Ability to take ownership, communicate complex topics clearly, and influence through expertise rather than formal authority
  • High enthusiasm for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement
  • Excellent communication skills in German and English


What’s Offered

  • Work on high-impact, real-world problems with direct operational relevance
  • End-to-end responsibility rather than isolated modelling tasks
  • Modern analytics and AI environment with room to shape best practices
  • Strong emphasis on quality, sustainability, and long-term impact
  • Collaborative, knowledge-driven culture with high professional standards
  • Competitive compensation and flexible working model

Im Data Analytics Team der HUK-COBURG transformieren wir Daten in echte Mehrwerte für über 13 Mio. Kund:innen. Als Deutschlands führende Kfz-Versicherung sind wir ein traditionsreiches und stabiles Unternehmen, welches zielgerichtet in Innovation und seine datengetriebene Zukunft investiert.   • Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung und fortlaufende Optimierung von Machine Learning- und Deep Learning-Modellen in laufende Prozesse unter Berücksichtigung von Geschwindigkeit, Genauigkeit, Leistung und Skalierbarkeit auf CPU- und GPU-Plattformen
  • Einsatz von aktuellen Machine Learning- und Deep Learning-Verfahren in einer professionellen DevOps Umgebung mit Python
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Übertragung modernster Data Science- und KI-Methoden aus der aktuellen Forschung auf praktische Unternehmensanforderungen
  • Teamarbeit in einem kreativen, motivierten, interdisziplinären sowie agilen Team aus Data Scientists (w/m/d), Machine Learning Engineers (w/m/d) und Fach- sowie IT-Expert:innen zur Integration von Machine Learning- und Deep Learning-Lösungen in unsere Produkte


Dein Profil:


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (mindestens Master, idealerweise Promotion) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematik, Physik, VWL, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
  • Idealerweise mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von skalierbaren Machine Learning-Lösungen in der Forschung, im forschungsnahen Umfeld oder in der Industrie, idealerweise in einer Senior-Position mit Projektleitungserfahrung
  • Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Python und fundierte, theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in modernen Machine Learning-Techniken und -Tools
  • Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte klar zu vermitteln
  • Selbstständige, zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Bereitschaft, Ownership für Projekte und Ergebnisse zu übernehmen
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Bereitschaft zur Präsenz in Coburg
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau)


Unsere Benefits:


  • Flexible Arbeitszeit & mobiles Arbeiten: Gleit- und Teilzeitmodelle, mobiles Arbeiten im Rahmen von New Work.
  • Urlaub & Freizeit: 31,5 Urlaubstage + Weihnachten und Silvester frei.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Attraktive Bezahlung mit 13,3 Monatsgehältern, Mobilitätszuschuss.
  • Weiterbildung: Unterstützung bei fachlicher und persönlicher Weiterbildung.
  • Beruf & Familie: Kinderbetreuung, Angehörigenpflege und Teilzeit-Führungspositionen.
  • Altersvorsorge: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Gesundheitsangebote und Mitarbeitendenberatung.

description: 1inch is the De Fi ecosystem building financial freedom for everyone. 1inch products help users and builders trade, hold and track digital assets - with the self-custody, comprehensive security and the intuitive user experience they need to unlock the potential of true crypto ownership. 1inch protocols and APIs provide core infrastructure across the De Fi industry and beyond. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Location: We prioritise candidates who are based in Dubai then consider those working remotely in one of our European Hub Locations (UK, Spain or Germany). We are seeking a talented Data Scientist with focus on product analytics to join our Data & Analytics team and drive data-driven decision making across our organisation. In this role, you will analyse complex datasets, conduct research, and provide valuable insights to support product strategy and business growth. You must have Data Science experience. Key Responsibilities Analyse and interpret large-scale on-chain and off-chain datasets to inform business decisions Design and maintain data collection processes and event storage systems Conduct research to identify patterns, trends, and growth opportunities Create intuitive dashboards and data visualisations for internal teams and external partners Propose and test hypotheses with empirical evidence Monitor and evaluate product metrics and user behaviour patterns Present findings and recommendations to stakeholder Requirements3+ years of experience in data/product analytics BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field Design and maintain data collection processes and event storage systems Conduct research to identify patterns, trends, and growth opportunities Experience creating intuitive dashboards and data visualisations for internal teams and external partners Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex findings to diverse stakeholders Proficiency in creating data visualizations and building analytical dashboards (Mixpanel, Metabase)Intermediate SQL, Python knowledge Familiarity with A/B tests and Casual Inference Understanding of product analytics and user behaviour analysis Nice to have Crypto/Web3 analytical stack (Dune, Nodes, Flipside)Low level blockchain data understanding (traces, events)Experience in uncovering business-driving data insights Why work for us? Join a young, creative team in a fast-paced and supportive environment We’re open to new ideas — if you’ve got a vision, pitch it and make it happen Enjoy competitive pay that matches your skills and experience Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of De Fi Take time when you need it — we offer unlimited vacation days Get fully compensated for your work gear — we’ll set you up for success We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. Munich (Hybrid) - 3 days in office.

€90,000 - €110,000

Retail / Consumer Business


We’re partnering with a fast-growing retail business that is investing heavily in data-driven marketing and commercial decision science.   • Support experimentation frameworks and incrementality testing
  • Communicate complex statistical outputs in a clear, business-friendly way


What They’re Looking For:

  • Strong experience building or owning MMM / media effectiveness models
  • Background in econometrics, statistics, data science, or quantitative economics
  • Hands-on with causal inference, regression modelling, and time-series analysis
  • Strong Python or R skills (SQL also expected)
  • Experience working with marketing data (paid media, digital channels, promotions, seasonality, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders outside of data teams


Why This Role is Interesting:

  • Direct impact on multi-million € marketing budgets
  • Retail environment = rich data + real commercial levers
  • Opportunity to build MMM capability into a core strategic function
  • Strong visibility with senior leadership

  • Marketing / Growth Data Science
  • Econometrics or Pricing Science
  • Experimentation / Incrementality roles
  • Media effectiveness modelling


If you’re a data scientist who wants your work to shape real business decisions, not just dashboards, this is the kind of role where your models genuinely matter.


Apply if you're interested in this role!

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Abu Dhabi (On site)

**This role requires relocation to Abu Dhabi**


We’re hiring Data Scientists to join one of our clients. If you’re passionate about turning data into meaningful insights and building impactful AI solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


What you’ll be doing

In this role, you’ll design and develop scalable machine learning models and AI-driven solutions that tackle complex business challenges and support smarter decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work with large, complex datasets to solve real-world business problems
  • Collect, clean, and preprocess data for analysis and model training
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover insights and guide model development
  • Build, train, and optimize machine learning models using modern algorithms and frameworks
  • Develop end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to model deployment
  • Automate model training, testing, and deployment using CI/CD and MLOps tools
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models into production systems and deliver complete solutions


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI
  • Strong knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, and areas such as NLP, computer vision, or generative AI (including LLMs)
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R, with working knowledge of SQL
  • Experience building data pipelines and working with big data tools (e.g. Spark, Airflow, Hadoop)
  • Understanding of model serving, APIs (FastAPI, Flask), and optimizing models for real-time or batch inference
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and MLOps tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow
  • Experience deploying models on cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure (e.g. SageMaker, Vertex AI)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field


If this sounds like the right next step for you, apply now!

Proven experience applying data science to A/B testing in marketing, growth, or user acquisition.
Strong hands-on background in statistical testing, experiment design, and result interpretation.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and experimentation workflows.
Experience working with performance data, SQL, and cloud-based data platforms.
Ability to communicate experiment results clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Move Fast: You thrive in fast-paced environments with continuous experimentation.

Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.
We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
Compensation Range: €70K - €85K

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70+ countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Data Scientist to join our Quick Commerce team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

We are redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You’ll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you’ll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

At Content & Assortment, we are building the AI engine that powers our global product catalog. We want every product to be perfectly described, categorized, and presented to our customers. Our mission is to automate and optimize the entire lifecycle of our product catalog—from creation and enrichment to categorization and curation—using advanced Machine Learning.

As a Data Scientist, you will work side-by-side with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Software Engineers to design, build, and deploy ML models that automate content creation and power a smarter product assortment.

This is a role for someone who has a strong background in applied ML, particularly in NLP, classification, or recommendation systems, and is hungry to solve complex catalog problems at scale. You will drive hypotheses, validate model accuracy, and bring ML-powered services for attribute enrichment, product categorization, and assortment curation into production with real business impact.

If you’re a strong coder with a problem-solving mentality and thrive in high-scale applied ML problems, we’d love to talk.

Your mission:

  • Design, experiment, and deploy AI/ML models/Agents to automate the enrichment and moderation of product attributes at scale.
  • Drive experimentation: formulate hypotheses, validate model performance , analyze business impact, and turn insights into production-ready models.
  • Develop and provide ML models to intelligently curate the product assortment, including attribute extraction, product categorization, category tree recommendations, and the curation of high-impact featured categories.
  • Keep yourself up to date and apply state-of-the-art models (e.g., in NLP, deep learning, classification, LLMs/AI agents) to see what truly works best for our catalog automation.
  • Collaborate closely with MLEs and Engineers to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and fast in production.
  • Contribute to the long-term vision of catalog automation and AI-driven assortment, while delivering short-term wins that unlock measurable business impact.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of industry experience applying Data Science and Machine Learning in production, ideally in large-scale consumer-facing applications.
  • Deep expertise in building and deploying ML models, particularly in Natural Language Processing (NLP), classification, recommendation systems and LLMs or agentic frameworks.
  • Strong statistical foundations and ability to distinguish signal from noise in large-scale experimentation and model validation.
  • Excellent engineering skills: write clean, maintainable Python code; experience bringing ML models into production with best practices for observability, monitoring, and performance.
  • Experience with large-scale ML model validation, experimentation, and A/B testing.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with engineers and product stakeholders, translating business problems into data science solutions.

Nice to have:

  • PhD in AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • Experience scaling catalog automation or content generation systems across multiple markets and heterogeneous platforms.
  • Experience in designing or building Agentic AI systems.
  • Experience in fine tuning Large Language Models.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP preferred).
  • Contributions to the data science community (conference talks, papers, OSS).

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

  • Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
  • We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
  • We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
  • Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
  • Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
  • The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
  • Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
  • Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.cominclude it in your application.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

Job Description

About the Opportunity

We are on the lookout for talented Associate Data Scientists to join our 2026 Tech Grad Program, on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Our Tech Grad Program offers you a unique environment for you to learn and develop your skills, and to contribute to the development of our cutting-edge tech solutions. You will have some of the most talented and experienced software engineers in the industry as mentors to help you ramp up, and a support group you can go to for help and connection.

Our Engineering organization consists of over 1,500 talented engineers distributed across our major verticals. Our tech employees are divided into different teams across the following areas: Consumer Data Products, FinTech, Logistics, Pandora, Platform, Quick Commerce, and Vendor Tech. They work on a range of major topics from boosting customer acquisition and retention to creating efficient experiences for our vendors, building an excellent logistics ecosystem across the delivery lifecycle, providing financial empowerment to our stakeholders and much more.

f you are an Engineering graduate looking for an opportunity to grow in the tech industry and make a difference, our Tech Graduate Program is for you! You can also visit our Early Careers @ Delivery Hero website for more information!

Important Information About This Position

Please note that we are pursuing a new, pilot hiring model for 2026. We are opening this job opportunity temporarily, during which time we will collect your applications.

If we choose to proceed with your application, you will go through our standard interview process (recruiter call, coding, technical concepts interview, hiring manager interview). When overall feedback is positive, we will place you in a pool of offerable candidates and reach out for next steps as soon as an Associate Data Scientist role becomes available in the org.

This role will stay open for applications until 6th February, 2026.

What you need to be Successful

To be eligible for our program, you must:

  • Have the right to live and work in Germany
    • Candidates within the EU are also eligible to apply as long as you meet the above criteria
  • Have (or be graduating from) a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science or a related field
    • If graduated, you may also have a maximum of 2 years of experience in similar job fields
    • Coding bootcamp graduates (recent/upcoming) are also eligible to apply and do not need to meet the degree requirement above; please apply if you have a minimum of 6-12 months’ internship/bootcamp experience
  • Have a good understanding of and direct experience with coding in relevant languages and technologies (see below), ideally from internships, bootcamps, or open-source projects
  • Be an analytical thinker and strong problem solver with a humble, inquisitive approach
  • Have good communication and collaboration skills
  • Be business fluent in English
  • Be excited about working in a fast-moving, agile company where we learn from our mistakes

Technical skills we look for:

  • SQL, noSQL, cloud services (AWS), data warehousing (BigQuery, Redshift)

Generally, we also expect your curiosity in learning/trying out new technologies.

Who we are

description: Übersetze mit uns Daten in wertvolle Erkenntnisse und beflügle den Innovationsprozess. Ab sofort suchen wir eine/n Data Scientist (Mensch) in unserem R&D-Team. Ob im Berliner Büro oder Remote, ob Teil- oder Vollzeit, wichtig ist uns der menschliche Match und die Begeisterung für deinen Bereich. Wenn du gemeinsam mit uns an der kreativen, nutzerzentrierten Entwicklung von Produkten und Projekten in den Bereichen des digitalen Wandels, Research & Developments wie auch Tech-Startup Acceleration kreativ wirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf ein baldiges Kennenlernen. Über das R&D Team: Unser R&D Team entwickelt innovative digitale Ansätze mit einem klaren Fokus auf den Menschen. Dabei erforschen wir, wie Technologie echten gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert schafft. Durch die Kombination von datengetriebener Forschung und kreativem Denken schaffen wir neuartige Ansätze. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf der Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von maschinellem Lernen (AI/AIOT), um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen und datenbasierte Innovationen voranzutreiben. Deine Mission Du extrahierst aus vielfältigen Datenquellen relevantes Wissen, entwickelst ML-Modelle zur Vorhersage von Verhaltensmustern und schaffst damit die Grundlage für intelligente, adaptive Assistenzsysteme. Aufgaben Analyse heterogener Datenquellen (z. B. Bewegungsmuster, Sprachnutzung, Interaktionsverläufe) zur Identifikation relevanter Nutzungsmuster Entwicklung von prädiktiven Modellen zur Erkennung von Bedarfssituationen in technologiegestützten Alltagsszenarien Ableitung und Validierung von datengestützten Handlungsempfehlungen auf Basis KI-gestützter Systeme Evaluation der Wirkung von Empfehlungen im Feldversuch mithilfe quantitativer Daten Qualifikation Dein Equipment Deutliche Erfahrung mit der Modellierung menschlicher Verhaltensmuster oder Kontextdaten Kenntnisse in Python sowie Libraries für Klassifikation, Clustering und Zeitreihenanalyse Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Wirkungsmessung, insbesondere im sozialen Kontext Fähigkeit, Datenmodelle kritisch-reflektiert im gesellschaftlichen Kontext zu interpretieren Bereitschaft zur iterativen Modellierung mit engem Bezug zur Nutzerrealität Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit Explainable AI im Kontext von Verhaltensentscheidungen Kenntnisse in der Analyse von Smart-Home- oder Io T-Daten Grundlagen im Bereich Human-Centered Machine Learning Fähigkeit zur Integration qualitativer Daten (z. B. Tagebuchstudien) in quantitative Modelle Erfahrung mit co-kreativen Auswertungsprozessen Benefits Was wir für dich haben Passionierte Kollegen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet Wie es weitergeht Du möchtest die Zukunft mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio/Lebenslauf sowie Angaben zu deinen Wünschen für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo. Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden Aktuell ist der Bewerbungsprozess überwiegend digital. Möchtest du direkt schon dein vielleicht zukünftiges Büro auch sehen, lass es uns wissen. Außerdem. Uns ist es wichtig, dass das Team dich auch kennenlernt. Daher würdest du bereits in der ersten Hälfte des Bewerbungsprozesses einen Teil deiner zukünftigen Kollegen:innen alle Fragen stellen können, die dich bewegen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
descriptionHtml:
Übersetze mit uns Daten in wertvolle Erkenntnisse und beflügle den Innovationsprozess.


Ab sofort suchen wir eine/n Data Scientist (Mensch) in unserem R&D-Team.


Ob im Berliner Büro oder Remote, ob Teil- oder Vollzeit, wichtig ist uns der menschliche Match und die Begeisterung für deinen Bereich. Wenn du gemeinsam mit uns an der kreativen, nutzerzentrierten Entwicklung von Produkten und Projekten in den Bereichen des digitalen Wandels, Research & Developments wie auch Tech-Startup Acceleration kreativ wirken möchtest, freuen wir uns auf ein baldiges Kennenlernen.


Über das R&D Team: Unser R&D Team entwickelt innovative digitale Ansätze mit einem klaren Fokus auf den Menschen. Dabei erforschen wir, wie Technologie echten gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert schafft. Durch die Kombination von datengetriebener Forschung und kreativem Denken schaffen wir neuartige Ansätze. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf der Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von maschinellem Lernen (AI/AIOT), um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen und datenbasierte Innovationen voranzutreiben.


Deine Mission

Du extrahierst aus vielfältigen Datenquellen relevantes Wissen, entwickelst ML-Modelle zur Vorhersage von Verhaltensmustern und schaffst damit die Grundlage für intelligente, adaptive Assistenzsysteme.


Aufgaben

  • Analyse heterogener Datenquellen (z. B. Bewegungsmuster, Sprachnutzung, Interaktionsverläufe) zur Identifikation relevanter Nutzungsmuster

  • Entwicklung von prädiktiven Modellen zur Erkennung von Bedarfssituationen in technologiegestützten Alltagsszenarien

  • Ableitung und Validierung von datengestützten Handlungsempfehlungen auf Basis KI-gestützter Systeme

  • Evaluation der Wirkung von Empfehlungen im Feldversuch mithilfe quantitativer Daten


Qualifikation

Dein Equipment



  • Deutliche Erfahrung mit der Modellierung menschlicher Verhaltensmuster oder Kontextdaten

  • Kenntnisse in Python sowie Libraries für Klassifikation, Clustering und Zeitreihenanalyse

  • Vertrautheit mit Methoden der Wirkungsmessung, insbesondere im sozialen Kontext

  • Fähigkeit, Datenmodelle kritisch-reflektiert im gesellschaftlichen Kontext zu interpretieren

  • Bereitschaft zur iterativen Modellierung mit engem Bezug zur Nutzerrealität


Gern gesehen, aber kein Muss



  • Erfahrung mit Explainable AI im Kontext von Verhaltensentscheidungen

  • Kenntnisse in der Analyse von Smart-Home- oder IoT-Daten

  • Grundlagen im Bereich Human-Centered Machine Learning

  • Fähigkeit zur Integration qualitativer Daten (z. B. Tagebuchstudien) in quantitative Modelle

  • Erfahrung mit co-kreativen Auswertungsprozessen


Benefits

Was wir für dich haben



  • Passionierte Kollegen in einer offenen Unternehmenskultur mit flacher Hierarchie

  • Berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung, gefördert und gefordert

  • Raum für Eigenverantwortung und eigene Ideen

  • Flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten

  • Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das die soziale und umweltbewusste Zukunft aktiv mitgestaltet


Wie es weitergeht


Du möchtest die Zukunft mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf dein Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio/Lebenslauf sowie Angaben zu deinen Wünschen für deine berufliche Zukunft zusammen mit uns und einem Hallo.


Wenn wir neugierig auf mehr werden


Aktuell ist der Bewerbungsprozess überwiegend digital. Möchtest du direkt schon dein vielleicht zukünftiges Büro auch sehen, lass es uns wissen. Außerdem. Uns ist es wichtig, dass das Team dich auch kennenlernt. Daher würdest du bereits in der ersten Hälfte des Bewerbungsprozesses einen Teil deiner zukünftigen Kollegen:innen alle Fragen stellen können, die dich bewegen.


Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

description: Your mission You actively shape your position, we want you to get involved and contribute ideas! Exploratory Data Analysis & Insights Conduct deep-dive exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, predict user behavior and optimize key performance metrics (e.g., retention, ROAS). Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics Design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning models for predictive analytics, recommendation systems and anomaly detection. Optimize data-driven strategies through AI/ML applications. Data Engineering & Pipeline Development Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation and high-quality model inputs. A/B Testing & Experimentation Design and execute rigorous A/B tests to validate hypotheses and assess the impact of new features. AI/ML Integration & Collaboration Work closely with engineering and product teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into enterprise applications. Ensure smooth deployment and scalability of machine learning models. Data-Driven Leadership & Best Practices Act as a thought leader, promoting data-driven decision-making and implementing best practices across the company. Your profile Must-Haves2–5 years of applying data-science methodologies end-to-end in production (not just prototyping)Built and maintained scalable data pipelines using Spark and Databricks for large-scale data ingestion and transformation Deployed at least one machine-learning model (Scikit-learn, PyTorch) into a production API or streaming pipeline Authored complex SQL for analytics and ETL on modern data warehouses Translated sophisticated mathematical and ML concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset Nice to Haves Familiarity with advanced experimentation techniques (causal inference, A/B testing, media mix modeling). Experience with deep learning and time series forecasting for business applications. Hands-on experience with ML monitoring tools (e.g., MLflow). Background in Ad Tech or marketing analytics. Why us? Work-Life Balance: 30 days of paid vacation. Commuter Benefits: Public transportation tickets provided. Professional Development: Annual education budget of €1,500. Workation Opportunities: Combine work and vacation annually. Wellness: Access to over 7,000 gyms and spas in Germany through Wellpass. Catering: Monthly team lunches, daily fruits, vegetables, and a variety of beverages. Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model. Corporate Benefits: Exclusive discounts for major brands and platforms. Diversity: Join an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds. Fun and Games: Socializing area for relaxing activities during the workday. Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday! :)About Us Welcome! Bonjour! Selam! Olá! Hej! We are a Hamburg based mobile marketing agency, connecting advertisers with their highest value users through our owned and operated apps. We created an innovative business model that focuses on rewarding users for testing and engaging with the apps of our clients. Our products are available in DACH, US, UK & Canada. Right now round about 80 employees from all over the world are working here with us in Hamburg. We are a divers & fun team, always looking for new talents to join us. Looking forward to meeting you!
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

You actively shape your position, we want you to get involved and contribute ideas!

Exploratory Data Analysis & Insights

  • Conduct deep-dive exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, predict user behavior and optimize key performance metrics (e.g., retention, ROAS).

Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics

  • Design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning models for predictive analytics, recommendation systems and anomaly detection.
  • Optimize data-driven strategies through AI/ML applications.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation and high-quality model inputs.

A/B Testing & Experimentation

  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests to validate hypotheses and assess the impact of new features.

AI/ML Integration & Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into enterprise applications.
  • Ensure smooth deployment and scalability of machine learning models.

Data-Driven Leadership & Best Practices

  • Act as a thought leader, promoting data-driven decision-making and implementing best practices across the company.

Your profile

Must-Haves

  • 2–5 years of applying data-science methodologies end-to-end in production (not just prototyping)
  • Built and maintained scalable data pipelines using Spark and Databricks for large-scale data ingestion and transformation
  • Deployed at least one machine-learning model (Scikit-learn, PyTorch) into a production API or streaming pipeline
  • Authored complex SQL for analytics and ETL on modern data warehouses
  • Translated sophisticated mathematical and ML concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with advanced experimentation techniques (causal inference, A/B testing, media mix modeling).
  • Experience with deep learning and time series forecasting for business applications.
  • Hands-on experience with ML monitoring tools (e.g., MLflow).
  • Background in AdTech or marketing analytics.

Why us?

  • Work-Life Balance: 30 days of paid vacation.
  • Commuter Benefits: Public transportation tickets provided.
  • Professional Development: Annual education budget of €1,500.
  • Workation Opportunities: Combine work and vacation annually.
  • Wellness: Access to over 7,000 gyms and spas in Germany through Wellpass.
  • Catering: Monthly team lunches, daily fruits, vegetables, and a variety of beverages.
  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model.
  • Corporate Benefits: Exclusive discounts for major brands and platforms.
  • Diversity: Join an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds.
  • Fun and Games: Socializing area for relaxing activities during the workday.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday! :)

About Us

Machine Learning & Predictive Analytics

Optimize data-driven strategies through AI/ML applications.
Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

A/B Testing & Experimentation

AI/ML Integration & Collaboration
Work closely with engineering and product teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into enterprise applications.

Data-Driven Leadership & Best Practices

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. With our unique combination of data, analytics and software, we have established ourselves as one of the leading service providers for risk, fraud and identity management in the DACH region.

Experian gives individuals better access to financial services such as loans, insurance, mobile phone contracts and online shopping. We help companies of all sizes and industries make smarter decisions, lend more responsibly and protect themselves and their customers from identity fraud and crime.

We invest in our talented people and new, advanced technologies to harness the power of data and drive innovation. We employ 25,100 people in 32 countries and are a FTSE 100 company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN). Our headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland.

Job Description

The Data Scientist plays a pivotal role in the development and application of advanced analytics and machine learning models to support the development, monitoring, and maintenance of our data products, including Scores, Attributes, and other Data Services. This role is integral to driving innovation and improving the performance of our products, working closely with our Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams ensuring data-driven decision-making.

The primary purpose of this role is to develop, implement, and maintain machine learning models and analytical solutions that enhance our data products. It also includes the monitoring of our Bureau Data Asset and the continues improvement of our Bureau Data Ingestion Pipeline.

Main focus of this role are product-related tasks with only limited or no involvement in client projects.

Main Responsibilities, Tasks, Duties

  • Develop and implement machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions
  • Monitor the performance and quality of our models and data products
  • Perform ad hoc analyses to support product development and decision-making
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams to understand functional requirements and to ensure proper implementation of analytical solutions, new product features and improve processes
  • Ensure model accuracy and integrity through rigorous testing and validation processes
  • Document methodologies, processes, and findings to maintain transparency and reproducibility
  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze data from data lake to support various product development and monitoring activities
  • Support our Legal and Compliance Teams in cases of consumer complaints, questions regarding our Scores and regulatory or policy changes
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and new developments in machine learning and data science

Responsibility, E.g. Budget, Key Deliverables

  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality machine learning models and analyses
  • Maintain and improve the accuracy and performance of our models and data products
  • Contribute to the development of new product features and enhancements
  • Support data-driven decision making within Product Management
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic decision-making

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail
  • Deep knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms, especially logistic regression and boosted trees and its application
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Scala
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as XGBoost, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
  • Experience with data manipulation and extraction from data lakes or large data storages using SQL and Spark
  • Proven ability to analyze complex business and risk processes, translating them into actionable data models
  • Excellent German language skills, both written and spoken, as well as fluent English language skills

Preferred Further Skills (not Mandatory)

  • We are not looking for a pure theorist: You should have the ability to interpret and apply analytical models within a business context. Ideally, you have demonstrated how to analyze business processes and translate them into data models to enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience in the credit bureau or financial services environment is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Strong ability to communicate complex analytical results clearly and provide actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Additional Information

What you will get:

  • A high degree of autonomy in a dynamic, internationally oriented organization
  • A motivated team that values innovation and collaboration
  • Great compensation package and attractive employee benefits
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options

Experian is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

descriptionHtml:
1inch is the DeFi ecosystem building financial freedom for everyone. 1inch products help users and builders trade, hold and track digital assets - with the self-custody, comprehensive security and the intuitive user experience they need to unlock the potential of true crypto ownership. 1inch protocols and APIs provide core infrastructure across the DeFi industry and beyond.

So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team.

Location: We prioritise candidates who are based in Dubai then consider those working remotely in one of our European Hub Locations (UK, Spain or Germany).

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help strengthen our growing Data & Analytics team. This role will play a key part in improving our data infrastructure, maintaining high data quality, and delivering fast, actionable insights across teams. They’ll also support product, business, and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics. Please note you must have experience working as a Data Scientist and this role is not for ML/AI engineers. Strong Data Scientist with SQL & Python experience.

Responsibilities

  • Actively shaping how company uses data for strategic decisions
  • Enhance data infrastructure and tooling for improved efficiency
  • Support critical business units with ad-hoc analytics and insights
  • Conduct deep-dive research and analysis to uncover actionable findings
  • Improve data collection and analytics processes across teams
  • Ensure dashboards provide clarity, usability, and real-time visibility



Requirements

  • Minimum 6+ years of experience in data science, data analytics, this role is not for an MI/AI engineer
  • Proven track record of implementing data infrastructure improvements and optimisations
  • Prior experience working with blockchain tools or DeFi data strongly preferred
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualisation tools
  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL processes, and data pipeline optimisation
  • Understanding of statistical concepts and practical experience applying them
  • Ability to translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights
  • Collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills to work effectively across teams



Nice to Have


  • Crypto/Web3 analytical stack (Dune, Nodes, Flipside)
  • Low level blockchain data understanding (traces, events)
  • Experience in uncovering business-driving data insights



Why Work For Us?


  • Join a young, creative team in a fast-paced and supportive environment
  • We’re open to new ideas — if you’ve got a vision, pitch it and make it happen
  • Enjoy competitive pay that matches your skills and experience
  • Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of DeFi
  • Take time when you need it — we offer unlimited vacation days
  • Get fully compensated for your work gear — we’ll set you up for success



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. With our unique combination of data, analytics and software, we have established ourselves as one of the leading service providers for risk, fraud and identity management in the DACH region. Experian gives individuals better access to financial services such as loans, insurance, mobile phone contracts and online shopping. We help companies of all sizes and industries make smarter decisions, lend more responsibly and protect themselves and their customers from identity fraud and crime. We invest in our talented people and new, advanced technologies to harness the power of data and drive innovation. We employ 25,100 people in 32 countries and are a FTSE 100 company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN). Our headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Job Description The Data Scientist plays a pivotal role in the development and application of advanced analytics and machine learning models to support the development, monitoring, and maintenance of our data products, including Scores, Attributes, and other Data Services. This role is integral to driving innovation and improving the performance of our products, working closely with our Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams ensuring data-driven decision-making. The primary purpose of this role is to develop, implement, and maintain machine learning models and analytical solutions that enhance our data products. It also includes the monitoring of our Bureau Data Asset and the continues improvement of our Bureau Data Ingestion Pipeline. Main focus of this role are product-related tasks with only limited or no involvement in client projects. Main Responsibilities, Tasks, Duties Develop and implement machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions Monitor the performance and quality of our models and data products Perform ad hoc analyses to support product development and decision-making Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams to understand functional requirements and to ensure proper implementation of analytical solutions, new product features and improve processes Ensure model accuracy and integrity through rigorous testing and validation processes Document methodologies, processes, and findings to maintain transparency and reproducibility Extract, manipulate, and analyze data from data lake to support various product development and monitoring activities Support our Legal and Compliance Teams in cases of consumer complaints, questions regarding our Scores and regulatory or policy changes Stay up to date on industry trends and new developments in machine learning and data science Responsibility, E.g. descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. With our unique combination of data, analytics and software, we have established ourselves as one of the leading service providers for risk, fraud and identity management in the DACH region.

Experian gives individuals better access to financial services such as loans, insurance, mobile phone contracts and online shopping. We help companies of all sizes and industries make smarter decisions, lend more responsibly and protect themselves and their customers from identity fraud and crime.

We invest in our talented people and new, advanced technologies to harness the power of data and drive innovation. We employ 25,100 people in 32 countries and are a FTSE 100 company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN). Our headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland.

Job Description

The Data Scientist plays a pivotal role in the development and application of advanced analytics and machine learning models to support the development, monitoring, and maintenance of our data products, including Scores, Attributes, and other Data Services. This role is integral to driving innovation and improving the performance of our products, working closely with our Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams ensuring data-driven decision-making.

The primary purpose of this role is to develop, implement, and maintain machine learning models and analytical solutions that enhance our data products. It also includes the monitoring of our Bureau Data Asset and the continues improvement of our Bureau Data Ingestion Pipeline.

Main focus of this role are product-related tasks with only limited or no involvement in client projects.

Main Responsibilities, Tasks, Duties

  • Develop and implement machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions
  • Monitor the performance and quality of our models and data products
  • Perform ad hoc analyses to support product development and decision-making
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Product & Tech teams to understand functional requirements and to ensure proper implementation of analytical solutions, new product features and improve processes
  • Ensure model accuracy and integrity through rigorous testing and validation processes
  • Document methodologies, processes, and findings to maintain transparency and reproducibility
  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze data from data lake to support various product development and monitoring activities
  • Support our Legal and Compliance Teams in cases of consumer complaints, questions regarding our Scores and regulatory or policy changes
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and new developments in machine learning and data science

Responsibility, E.g. Budget, Key Deliverables

  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality machine learning models and analyses
  • Maintain and improve the accuracy and performance of our models and data products
  • Contribute to the development of new product features and enhancements
  • Support data-driven decision making within Product Management
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic decision-making

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail
  • Deep knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms, especially logistic regression and boosted trees and its application
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Scala
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as XGBoost, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
  • Experience with data manipulation and extraction from data lakes or large data storages using SQL and Spark
  • Proven ability to analyze complex business and risk processes, translating them into actionable data models
  • Excellent German language skills, both written and spoken, as well as fluent English language skills

Preferred Further Skills (not Mandatory)

  • We are not looking for a pure theorist: You should have the ability to interpret and apply analytical models within a business context. Ideally, you have demonstrated how to analyze business processes and translate them into data models to enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience in the credit bureau or financial services environment is a plus, but not mandatory
  • Strong ability to communicate complex analytical results clearly and provide actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Additional Information

What you will get:

  • A high degree of autonomy in a dynamic, internationally oriented organization
  • A motivated team that values innovation and collaboration
  • Great compensation package and attractive employee benefits
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options

Experian is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. This is not a research role and not a reporting role. It is applied decision science in a real-world, high-noise environment, with clear success metrics and tight feedback loops. Analyze large, noisy datasets to identify high-impact pricing levers (day-of-week effects, events, demand compression, competitor pricing, LOS controls, overbooking effects). Build models that balance statistical rigor with operational constraints — accuracy and robustness matter more than theoretical elegance. Support fast experimentation cycles by defining model changes, success metrics, and analytical readouts. Solid track record designing and evaluating experiments and causal inference frameworks. ABOUT NUMA

Hey there! We’re Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
We’re not just transforming the guest experience—we’re revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences.
At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every voice is valued, and different perspectives fuel our innovation.

About the Role

This is the first Data Science hire for PUMA, numa’s in-house Revenue Management System.

Your mission is simple and demanding: find the gold nuggets in the data and convert them into production-ready models that drive measurable revenue impact — fast.

You will work closely with the PUMA Product Manager, who owns product vision, roadmap, and stakeholder alignment. Your role is to solve the hard analytical problems, validate hypotheses quantitatively, and translate them into models that can be automated and scaled.

This is not a research role and not a reporting role. It is applied decision science in a real-world, high-noise environment, with clear success metrics and tight feedback loops.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, implement, and iterate on pricing, demand forecasting, and elasticity models under the guidance of the Product Manager.
  • Analyze large, noisy datasets to identify high-impact pricing levers (day-of-week effects, events, demand compression, competitor pricing, LOS controls, overbooking effects).
  • Build models that balance statistical rigor with operational constraints — accuracy and robustness matter more than theoretical elegance.
  • Support fast experimentation cycles by defining model changes, success metrics, and analytical readouts.
  • Own post-experiment analysis: causal inference, uplift estimation, and clear, data-backed recommendations to the PM.
  • Prepare models for production use: stability checks, explainability, edge-case handling.
  • Contribute to logic for event detection, demand shocks, and high-compression periods.
  • Translate analytical results into clear, implementable pricing logic for engineers and the Product Manager.
What Success Looks Like (First 12–18 Months)
  • Measurable RevPAR uplift versus external RMS benchmarks.
  • Forecast error consistently within ±3%.
  • Multiple pricing levers live in production, not stuck in analysis.
  • Experiments shipping every sprint — not quarterly.
Required Experience & ProfileMust-Have
  • 6–10+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, or applied decision science.
  • Big Plus: Proven experience in dynamic pricing, revenue optimization, or demand forecasting environments.
  • Strong applied background in statistics, econometrics, or a highly quantitative field.
  • Solid track record designing and evaluating experiments and causal inference frameworks.
  • Ability to work independently on complex analytical problems, with guidance on priorities but not on execution.
Mindset & Traits
  • A true data nerd with strong commercial instincts.
  • Obsessed with real-world impact, not model elegance.
  • Comfortable making decisions under uncertainty.
  • Low ego, high ownership, high speed.
  • Thinks in expected value, not opinions.
Why Join numa / PUMA
  • Work on one of the most commercially impactful problems in hospitality.
  • Direct ownership over models that influence hundreds of millions in revenue.
  • Minimal hierarchy, fast decisions, and real autonomy.
  • A Product partner focused on learning speed and outcomes, not vanity metrics.
ABOUT OUR OFFER
  • Empower your career: Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas help shape our future. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and build a fulfilling career path.
  • Experience our brand: Immerse yourself in the Numa lifestyle with a complimentary stay. Share the love with friends and family through exclusive discounts on our stylish apartments. Connect with a global community of colleagues at our inspiring team-building events.

Numa values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at our company means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognised, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilise each person’s talents and strengths. We therefore welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, disability statuses, ages, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

For more information on the processing of your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.
