Umsetzungskompetenz: Du kannst Data & AI Use Cases erfolgreich in die Praxis umsetzen – von der Ideenfindung bis zur operativen Realisierung. Du verstehst es, Lösungen pragmatisch und zielorientiert zu implementieren und so messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Strategisches und wirtschaftliches Denken: Du verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und richtest deine Maßnahmen an langfristigen Zielen aus, um sowohl operative als auch strategische Mehrwerte zu schaffen. Tool-Stack: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Tools und Technologien wie zum Beispiel Python, PySpark, SQL, Excel, n8n, APIs, ... und kannst dich schnell in neue Tools einarbeiten. Leidenschaft und Eigenverantwortung: Du brennst für datengetriebene Lösungen, möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen und suchst kontinuierlich nach neuen Herausforderungen, um dich weiterzuentwickeln. Sprachen: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1+), gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Benefits Du arbeitest in einem jungen, wachsenden Team mit der Möglichkeit, twomynds aktiv mitzugestalten und sehr nah an Geschäftsprozessen und Entscheidungen dabei zu sein. Möglichkeit, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen, intern aufzusteigen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – unterstützt durch Mentoring, Sparring und Weiterbildungsbudget. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hohe Remote-Flexibilität. Du arbeitest an spannenden Projekten mit bekannten Marken aus Medien, Sport, Telekommunikation und Industrie – von strategischen Konzepten über Enablement bis zur Umsetzung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir melden uns garantiert innerhalb von 10 Tagen mit einer Rückmeldung bei dir.

descriptionHtml:
Our mission is to empower dental clinics with Roger, our next-generation automated workflows. Roger transforms treatment planning and patient communication, streamlines workflows, boosts efficiency and increases revenue for dental teams.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs and backed by top investors from Europe and the US, we’re now looking for a sharp, driven, and curious Product Analyst to join our product team. If you love working in fast-paced environments, turning data into decisions, and having a real impact—this is your chance.


Tasks

As a Data Analyst at Roger, you will:



  • Be the analytical backbone of the company: Turn complex data into clear insights that inform product strategy, feature impact, and business decisions.

  • Partner across domains: Support stakeholders in Product, Revenue Operations, and Marketing with reliable analyses tailored to their goals.

  • Discover what truly matters: Run exploratory analyses, form and validate hypotheses, and help the team continuously improve the product through data-driven learning.

  • Own product reporting end-to-end: Build and maintain dashboards, deep dives, and ad-hoc analyses that create shared clarity for product, design, and engineering teams.

  • Create direct customer value: Deliver meaningful insights to our largest customers, helping them better understand and optimize their own data.

  • Shape and safeguard our data model: Co-develop and evolve dbt models with Data Scientists, ensuring high data quality, consistency, and trust.

  • Collaborate deeply across Roger: Work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and founders to enable smarter, faster decisions across the company.


Requirements

What you bring



  • Strong command of SQL: You write clean, efficient, and well-structured queries and understand how to model data for exploration and analysis.

  • Product analytics experience: You’ve worked with SaaS or digital products—ideally in a B2B environment—and know how to measure product usage, funnels, and outcomes.

  • Detail-oriented, pattern-driven: You’re precise in your work, yet able to zoom out, spot trends, and connect signals across datasets.

  • Curious and analytical mindset: You don’t just answer questions—you challenge assumptions, ask better ones, and design meaningful ways to measure what matters.

  • Depth over surface insights: You go beyond first results, investigate root causes, uncover patterns, and translate findings into clear recommendations.

  • Clear communicator: You turn complex analyses into concise, actionable insights tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Collaborative team player: You thrive in a remote-first, cross-functional setup and enjoy partnering with product, engineering, and business teams.


Big Bonus points if you have


Experience with dbt, data modeling, or data warehouse design



  • Hands-on experience with Looker Studio, Lightdash, Power BI, or Tableau

  • Python skills for analysis, automation, or experimentation

  • Exposure to data science, machine learning, or AI-driven analytics in a product context


Benefits

Why Roger?



  • A Learning journey that doesn’t end: Be part of a fast-scaling team with clear paths to personal and professional development.

  • Meaningful impact: Your work will directly improve the lives of dentists and patients alike.

  • Modern tech stack: Work with best-in-class tools in a supportive, high-performance environment.

  • Vibrant culture: Join a team that values collaboration, curiosity, and fun—especially when working on hard problems.

  • Competitive compensation: Attractive salary, equity options, and benefits that grow with your contribution.


Ready to turn data into impact and be a key part of transforming dental healthcare?

Apply now and let us know your earliest possible start date. We can’t wait to meet you!
